description: Find Biohotspot map layers by words (e.g. 'seagrass', 'coral bleaching') among its 1,600+ world layers. Returns ids, names and categories (25 by default), and whether each can be read with get_features: only layers whose licence lets Biohotspot share their features are (the others still show in look_here and look_in_area). Also finds the Exmouth Gulf example project's open layers (exmouth_…). Read-only.
name: find_layers
title: Find map layers
